name: AccessVT
tagline: An updated, interactive campus accessibility map with route planning and AR guidance.

awards: VTHacks - Best Hack That Didn't Work

problem: The campus accessibility map was years out of date.
solution: A Mapbox map with custom accessible routes plans paths from your location, with an AR guide reached by QR code.
demo_moment: Team-described: plan an accessible route between buildings.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “VTHacks - Best Hack That Didn't Work” among 112 submissions.

lessons: Fixing an outdated local resource is a credible pitch even when the demo falters.
